description: Defines the ImageProcessor class for converting and scaling video frames, including configuration, processing, and backend interaction within ChromeOS media GPU pipeline.

classes.name: ImageProcessor
classes.description: Manages video frame format conversion, scaling, and backend processing within ChromeOS GPU media pipeline.

classes.name: PixelLayoutCandidate
classes.description: Represents a candidate pixel layout with format, size, and modifier.

classes.name: ClientCallback
classes.description: Holds callback functions for processed frames, supporting both current and legacy callback types.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate an ImageProcessor with specified backend creation callback and configurations.

methods.name: backend_type
methods.description: Returns the type of the backend used.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes a video frame asynchronously, invoking a callback upon completion.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets internal state, allowing processing of new frames.

methods.name: supports_incoherent_bufs
methods.description: Indicates if incoherent buffer support is available.
